ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Read the constraints from the text of the problem: x≤3, x+y≥2, y≤x; the objective expression is x+2y. Since the coefficient 2 of y in the objective expression is positive, when x is fixed, to make x+2y as large as possible, y should be increased as much as possible. From the constraint y≤x, it can be known that when x is fixed, the maximum value of y is y=x. Therefore x+2y≤x+2x=3x. Also because x≤3, 3x≤9, and thus x+2y≤9. Check whether equality can be attained: take x=3, y=3, then x≤3 holds, x+y=6≥2 holds, y≤x holds, and the objective value is 3+2×3=9. Therefore the maximum value is 9.
